type HostAllowance struct
  Hosts []string
type PickRequest struct
  Model string
  Fresh bool
  Allowed *HostAllowance
  Profile string
type Caller struct
  UserDescription string
  PathDescription string
type Observation struct
  Caller Caller
  TookMs int64
  CacheAgeMs int64
type Alias struct
  Host string
  Name string
  Resident bool
  Servable bool
  Hosted bool
  Profiles []string
  HeldIn []string
  ContextLength int64
  EffectiveContextLength int64
type Component struct
  Store string
  Role string
  Name string
type Family struct
  Family string
  Names []Alias
  HeldIn []string
  FamilySource string
  Components []Component
type ModelsSnapshot struct
  Observation Observation
  Models []Family
type HostState struct
  Host string
  Base string
  Up bool
  Why string
  Installed int64
  Resident []string
  Servable bool
  Hosted bool
  Wire string
  Credential string
  DeclaredBy string
  Profiles []string
  Domain string
  AvailabilityCause *AvailabilityCause
type Ask struct
  At string
  Caller string
  User string
  Model string
  Family string
  Verdict string
  Host string
type HostsSnapshot struct
  Observation Observation
  Hosts []HostState
  Doubled []string
  Asked []Ask
type Decision struct
  Asked string
  Family string
  Verdict string
  Host string
  Model string
  Endpoint string
  InstalledOn []string
  Authorised *HostAllowance
  Withheld []string
  Loads int64
  Why string
type PickResult struct
  Observation Observation
  Decision Decision
type OfferRequest struct
  Profile string
  Placement Placement
  Reserve int64
  Fresh bool
type Offer struct
  Family string
  Names []string
  Servers []string
  Context int64
  ContextSource ContextSource
  Input int64
  Unknown []string
type OfferSnapshot struct
  Observation Observation
  Offers []Offer
  Outcome OfferOutcome
func Encode(v *PickRequest) []byte
type Refusal struct
  Word string
  Offset int
func (Refusal) Error() string
func Decode(in []byte) (*PickRequest, error)
type FrameWriter interface
  WriteFrame(frame []byte) error
type DispatchError string
func (DispatchError) Error() string
type FrameExchanger interface
  ExchangeFrame(frame []byte) ([]byte, error)
type ServiceError struct
  Code ServiceErrorCode
  Message string
func (ServiceError) Error() string
const EndpointContract
type DescribedService interface
  DescribeService() (contract string, ready bool, why string)
func DescribeEndpoint(frame []byte, program, version string, services ...DescribedService) ([]byte, error)
type ServedService interface
  DescribedService
  ServiceContract() string
func ServeEndpoint(frame []byte, program, version string, services ...ServedService) ([]byte, error)
type Router interface
  Models(fresh bool) (ModelsSnapshot, error)
  Hosts(fresh bool) (HostsSnapshot, error)
  Pick(request PickRequest) (PickResult, error)
  Offer(request OfferRequest) (OfferSnapshot, error)
type RouterTransport interface
  FrameExchanger
type RouterClient struct
func NewRouterClient(t RouterTransport) *RouterClient
type RouterDispatcher struct
  Handler Router
func (RouterClient) Models(fresh bool) (result ModelsSnapshot, err error)
func (RouterClient) Hosts(fresh bool) (result HostsSnapshot, err error)
func (RouterClient) Pick(request PickRequest) (result PickResult, err error)
func (RouterClient) Offer(request OfferRequest) (result OfferSnapshot, err error)
func (RouterDispatcher) DescribeService() (contract string, ready bool, why string)
func (RouterDispatcher) DescribeServiceMetadata() (guarantees []string, capabilities map[string]string)
func (RouterDispatcher) ServiceContract() string
func (RouterDispatcher) WriteFrame(frame []byte) error
func (RouterDispatcher) ExchangeFrame(frame []byte) ([]byte, error)
